plan.goal: Size the per-chromosome PLINK binary .bed files for a GWAS genotype dataset of 16799 samples and 1931336 variants (498278 on the largest chromosome).
plan.rationale: The dataset is split into one .bed file per chromosome. The per-chromosome file size follows the 2-bits-per-sample-per-variant packing rule: B = n_samples × n_variants / 4 / 1e6 MB. For the largest chromosome (498278 variants) this gives ~2092.6 MB; the full dataset (1931336 variants) gives ~8111.1 MB. The number of per-chromosome files equals the number of chromosomes represented in the dataset (typically 24-25 for human GWAS: 22 autosomes + X + Y + MT).
caveats: The number of per-chromosome files equals the number of chromosomes carrying variants in the dataset; confirm the chromosome count (typically 24-25 for human GWAS) from the variant-to-chromosome mapping.
